open(p,'w').write('''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_row = next((i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1), None)
    if sep_row is not None:
        a, b = grid[:sep_row], grid[sep_row + 1:]
        common = set(v for row in a for v in row) & set(v for row in b for v in row)
        color = next(iter(common))
        return [[3 if a[i][j] == color and b[i][j] == color else color for j in range(w)] for i in range(len(a))]
    sep_col = next((j for j in range(w) if len({grid[i][j] for i in range(h)}) == 1), None)
    a = [row[:sep_col] for row in grid]
    b = [row[sep_col + 1:] for row in grid]
    common = set(v for row in a for v in row) & set(v for row in b for v in row)
    color = next(iter(common))
    return [[3 if a[i][j] == color and b[i][j] == color else color for j in range(len(a[0]))] for i in range(h)]
''')
